law: Filing is frozen as of 2026-08-25. A mark's directory is its historical filing: it carries no claim, and it never moves again. New marks are filed by identity - WORLD/marks/<household>/<slug>/ - and containment lives only in the derived fold, emitted as an artifact each settlement.
never_regenerated: This manifest IS the fossil's boundary. It is minted once and never rebuilt: rebuilding it would re-bless whatever the tree happens to say that day, which is the one thing the freeze exists to prevent. A mark born after the freeze needs no row here - its path is derivable from its id.

reframed.ruling: POS-441 (Darko, 2026-10-07): moving a mark carries the marks inside it that belong to the same household; another household's marks never move. "That should just always be the default rule."
reframed.why: another household's marks never ride your frame: each fossil filed inside another household's mark was re-filed at its id with its world place kept exactly (tools/unnest-households.mjs); its household's own marks and the predicates on it moved with it, keeping their frame. These rows are amended by name, never regenerated. `ground` is each mark's containment parent, unchanged by the move.
